name: Guitar Pal

en.taglineLong: Write a strumming pattern or a fingerpicking tab, or read one off a photo, and get a link that plays it on real guitar samples.
en.registryDescription: Strumming patterns and fingerpicking tabs, written or read off a photo, as links that play.
en.description:
Guitar Pal turns guitar music into a link you can hear.

Ask for a strumming pattern over your chords, a fingerpicking exercise, a short riff, or show a photo or screenshot of a tab, and Guitar Pal checks what was written and gives back a link. The link opens a full player in the browser: play it on real guitar samples, loop a section, slow it down, and import it into your own library to edit. No account is needed to connect or to open a link.

What it does:
- Strumming patterns: a rhythm in down, up and muted strokes, with a chord per bar, a tempo and a capo.
- Fingerpicking tabs: notes on an exact rhythmic grid, with hammer-ons, pull-offs, slides, bends, vibrato, palm mutes and more.
- Tabs from images: a tab read off a photo, scan or screenshot keeps its written note values, and the places that were hard to read are listed on the page to check against the original.
- Reading a link back, to change it and make a new one.

Every result passes the same validators the Guitar Pal app uses, so a link always plays. Playback is the app's own sample engine replaying what was written; Guitar Pal does not generate audio. Each link is a public snapshot that expires after 30 days.
prompts: Make me a Guitar Pal strumming pattern for C G Am F at 90 bpm.
Use Guitar Pal to write a slow 6/8 fingerpicking pattern over Am–F–C–G.
Bring this tab into Guitar Pal so I can play it back.
en.releaseNotes: First release: propose_strum, propose_tab, import_tab and read_share. Links play in the Guitar Pal player and expire after 30 days.

zh.taglineLong: 写一个扫弦节奏或一段指弹谱，或者从照片里读一张六线谱，得到一个用真实吉他采样播放的链接。
zh.description:
Guitar Pal 把吉他谱变成一个能听的链接。

让它写一个配你和弦的扫弦节奏、一段指弹练习、一小段 riff，或者发一张六线谱的照片或截图给它，Guitar Pal 会先检查写出来的内容，再给你一个链接。链接打开就是浏览器里的完整播放器：用真实吉他采样播放，循环某一段，放慢速度，还能导入自己的曲库编辑。连接和打开链接都不需要账号。

能做什么：
- 扫弦节奏：下扫、上扫、闷音组成的节奏，每小节一个和弦，可设速度和变调夹。
- 指弹谱：音符落在精确的节奏网格上，支持击弦、勾弦、滑音、推弦、揉弦、手掌闷音等技巧。
- 从图片读谱：从照片、扫描件或截图读出的谱子保留原来写的时值，读不准的地方会列在页面上，方便对照原谱检查。
- 读回一个链接，修改后生成新链接。

每个结果都经过 Guitar Pal 应用自己的校验，所以链接一定能播放。声音是应用的采样引擎在回放写好的谱，Guitar Pal 不生成音频。每个链接都是一份公开快照，30 天后失效。
prompts: 用 Guitar Pal 给我一个 C G Am F 的扫弦节奏，90 拍。
用 Guitar Pal 写一段 Am F C G 的慢速 6/8 指弹。
把这张谱导入 Guitar Pal，我想听听。
zh.releaseNotes: 首个版本：propose_strum、propose_tab、import_tab、read_share 四个工具。链接在 Guitar Pal 播放器里播放，30 天后失效。
